name: Syncretism
overview: Scripture sternly warns against syncretism, the blending of God’s truth with false practices or beliefs, as seen in the prohibition against adding to or diminishing God’s commands (Deuteronomy 4:2; Revelation 22:18). The Old Testament condemns adopting abominable customs of other gods, including idolatry and detestable rites (Deuteronomy 12:31; Zephaniah 1:5). Christ alone is the exclusive way to the Father (John 14:6), and believers are called to mature in faith to avoid being swayed by deceptive doctrines that mix error with truth (Ephesians 4:14).
